name: MvPolynomial.taylor_map
source:
theorem taylor_map {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (α : σ → R) (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    taylor (fun j ↦ f (α j)) (map f P) = map f (taylor α P) := by
  simp [taylor, aeval_def, map_eval₂, Function.comp_def]
